scenario: A genuine invoice with a disputed quantity is held for correction

facts: The buyer received and ordered 20 kg, while the invoice says 40 kg.

input: INVOICE WO-3218 from Wing On Meats. Pork shoulder 40 kg. Amount due: 600.00. The approved order and receipt show only 20 kg. This is a clerical quantity error: hold this invoice and ask the owners to verify the corrected document.
